title: Monitor False Positive Rate Under Distribution Shift: MALT-Trained Monitors on New Task Families

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly tests operational readiness of current best monitors. High FPR on new domains would mean MALT monitors are not deployment-ready, which is critical practical information.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompted monitors are API-based and well-documented. Applying them to new task families from public benchmarks is straightforward. No GPU needed for this variant. Very accessible for intro-ML students.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Train on MALT, test on 1-2 new domains, report FPR. Clean experimental design with clear deliverable. Easily within 30 hours.
